laws.rule: Kumamoto City accommodation tax started on 1 July 2026: JPY 200 a person a night (about A$1.80, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82) for anyone staying at a lodging in the city, paid to the lodging. It is the first in the prefecture.

festivals.what: Yamaga Toro Festival, Yamaga City: 15 and 16 August each year; fireworks over the Kikuchi River on the 15th, and the Sennin Toro Odori (about 1,000 women dancing with paper lanterns on their heads) on the night of the 16th.

layers.process: Mt Aso is at volcanic alert level 2 (lowered from 3 on 1 Sep 2026). Entry within about 1 km of the Nakadake crater is banned; the 2 km restriction and the Sarayama trail closure were lifted. The level can change; check the Japan Meteorological Agency and the Aso Volcano Disaster Prevention Council before going.
